name: Adaptive Depth Sampling with Voxel Layer Alignment
definition: An acceleration technique for ray traversal that reduces trilinear interpolation cost by aligning sample points with voxel layers to use bilinear interpolation, and skipping intermediate samples via adaptive depth sampling.
summary: Adaptive Depth Sampling with Voxel Layer Alignment is a ray traversal acceleration technique that reduces computational cost by aligning samples with voxel layers for cheaper bilinear interpolation and skipping intermediate points.
